title: 第17章 柳紫嫣 你觉得你很幽默第18章 醉仙楼
content_zh:
阴阳邪魔功，又分阴卷与阳卷。
女修阴，男修阳。
正常情况下，与异性进行双修，可以使修炼了阴阳邪魔功之人快速提升修为，甚至是突破境界瓶颈。
但如果双方都修炼了阴阳邪魔功，那么在阴阳调和，阴卷与阳卷互采互补的均衡下。
就能得出一加一大于二的效果。
这也是为何，即使阴阳邪魔功会绑定初次双修之人的阴气或阳气的限制下。
它仍然是大陆亿万邪修所追崇的至高邪修功法。
即使灵脉品阶不算出众，修炼天赋与悟性都比较普通的条件下。
只要道侣之间都修炼了阴阳邪魔功，那么就能修炼出堪比天骄般的恐怖效果。
所以，林陌成功修成了阴阳邪魔功，于柳紫嫣而言，确实是一个天大的好消息。
但这件事，她显然是不会告诉林陌的。
旋即，柳紫嫣玉手凌空一握，存放于林陌储物戒中的玉石卷轴当即飞掠而出，落入柳紫嫣手中。
林陌倒是不在乎阳卷的修炼之法被收回，反正他已经练成了。
“老夫有一个小忙，还望掌门大人帮帮忙。”
“杂役部的事？”
柳紫嫣问。
“是。”
林陌微微颔首。
他不确定接任杂役部新一任管事的周泽会不会来找自己麻烦，但这种麻烦，还是避免为好。
所以，林陌寻思着，能不能让柳紫嫣出面摆平这件事。

不然他修炼都没得一个安宁。
“一点不足挂齿的小事，还需本宫出面？你这老奴，脑子糊涂了？”
柳紫嫣兴致勃勃道：“若是连几个杂役部的蝼蚁都摆不平，你于本宫而言，还有何利用价值？”
杀蚂蚁还用牛刀？这不是拉低她的身价吗？
“.......”
林陌一阵语塞，果然他就不该指望柳紫嫣。
不过仔细想来，柳紫嫣所言并非没有道理。
让她出面去解决杂役部的事情，确实有点那啥了。
“不过...”
片刻，柳紫嫣玉指轻叹，又是一枚储物戒落至林陌身前，“看在你这老奴修成了阴阳邪魔功的份上，本宫姑且算你还有一点价值。”
“这里是一千颗灵石，且拿去修炼吧。”
“若你能自己摆平杂役部的事情，本宫再赏你五千颗灵石，若是摆不平，便自求多福吧。”
“掌门大人，这如何使得？”
嘴上说着不要，林陌的身体倒是挺老实。
当场就捡起了地上储物戒，以迅雷不及掩耳之势揣进了自己兜里。
在初圣宗，地位连狗都不如的杂役，一年的薪酬也就一颗灵石。
所以，对林陌来说，一千颗灵石，无疑是一笔巨款了。
也因此，当你成为初圣宗的一名杂役弟子之后，想要翻身农奴把歌唱，其难度不亚于登天！
“不要？不要还给本宫。”
“掌门大人，您也不缺这一千灵石，送出去的东西，就像泼出去的水，哪有收回的道理，您说是吧。”

林陌厚脸皮地道。
“你觉得你很幽默？”
柳紫嫣冷着一张脸。
但其实她有点被逗乐了。
以前她怎么没发现，林陌还有点幽默细胞？
content_en:
The yin and yang evil skills are divided into yin volume and yang volume.
Women cultivate Yin and men cultivate Yang.
Under normal circumstances, practicing dual cultivation with the opposite sex can enable people who have practiced Yin and Yang Demonic Skills to quickly improve their cultivation level, and even break through the bottleneck of their realm.
But if both parties practice Yin and Yang Demonic Skills, then under the balance of Yin and Yang harmony, Yin and Yang scrolls complement each other.
You can get the effect of one plus one being greater than two.
This is why even the yin and yang evil skills will be bound to the Yin Qi or Yang Qi of a person who is practicing dual cultivation for the first time.
It is still the supreme evil cultivation method pursued by hundreds of millions of evil cultivators in mainland China.
Even if the spiritual pulse level is not outstanding, the cultivation talent and understanding are relatively ordinary.
As long as Taoist couples practice Yin and Yang Demonic Skills, they can achieve terrifying effects comparable to those of geniuses.
Therefore, Lin Mo successfully mastered the Yin and Yang Demonic Skills, which was indeed great news for Liu Ziyan.
But she obviously wouldn't tell Lin Mo about this.
Immediately, Liu Ziyan held her jade hand in the air, and the jade scroll stored in Lin Mo's storage ring flew out and fell into Liu Ziyan's hand.
Lin Mo didn't care that Yang Juan's cultivation method was withdrawn, since he had already mastered it.
"I have a small favor, and I hope the master can help me."
"What about the handyman department?"
Liu Ziyan asked.
"Yes."
Lin Mo nodded slightly.
He was not sure whether Zhou Ze, who had taken over as the new manager of the Miscellaneous Services Department, would cause trouble for him, but it was better to avoid such trouble.
Therefore, Lin Mo was wondering if Liu Ziyan could be asked to come forward to settle this matter.
Otherwise, he would not even have peace in his cultivation.
"It's such a trivial matter, why do you still need my intervention? Are you an old slave, are you confused?"
Liu Ziyan said enthusiastically: "If you can't even deal with a few ants in the handyman department, what value do you have for me?"
Are you using a knife to kill ants? Doesn't this lower her worth?
"...."
Lin Mo was speechless for a while. Sure enough, he shouldn't count on Liu Ziyan.
But if you think about it carefully, what Liu Ziyan said is not unreasonable.
Asking her to come forward to solve the affairs of the handyman department is indeed a bit too much.
"But..."
After a moment, Liu Ziyan sighed softly with her jade finger, and another storage ring fell in front of Lin Mo, "For the sake of you, an old slave, who has mastered the yin and yang evil skills, I will assume that you still have some value."
"Here are a thousand spiritual stones. Let's use them to practice."
"If you can settle the affairs of the Miscellaneous Affairs Department on your own, I will reward you with another five thousand spiritual stones. If you can't settle it, just ask for more blessings."
"Sir, how can this be done?"
Although he said no, Lin Mo's body was quite honest.
He picked up the storage ring on the spot and put it into his pocket at lightning speed.
In the Chu Sheng Sect, a handyman whose status is not even as good as a dog's salary is only one spiritual stone a year.
Therefore, for Lin Mo, a thousand spirit stones were undoubtedly a huge sum of money.
Therefore, when you become a handyman disciple of Chu Sheng Sect, it is as difficult as climbing to the sky if you want to become a serf and sing!
"No? Don't give it back to me."
"Sir, you don't lack these thousand spirit stones. What you give out is like water thrown out. There is no reason to take it back, don't you think?"
Lin Mo said shamelessly.
"You think you're funny?"
Liu Ziyan had a cold face.
But she was actually a little amused.
Why hadn't she noticed before that Lin Mo still had a sense of humor?
